title: Saga Payloads: Checkout Reaches CONFIRMED
summary: Fix the checkout saga's event payloads (G3, G4) so a paid order reaches CONFIRMED with its stock taken, and an out-of-stock or declined order reaches CANCELLED with a visible reason and its stock returned.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Payments always succeed: 10 of 10 orders reach CONFIRMED, each within 10 s.
Each confirmed order has exactly one COMPLETED payment for its total, visible to the owner.
Confirmed: available stock down by the item quantity, reserved back to before.
Payments always fail: 10 of 10 reach CANCELLED within 10 s, one FAILED payment each, stock back exactly.
Out of stock: CANCELLED within 10 s, no payment, stock unchanged.
Cancelled orders show the reason (out of stock / payment declined) in the API and on the Orders page.
A saga event delivered twice creates no second payment, no double stock change, no status change.
Payment event processed before inventory.reserved still ends CONFIRMED/CANCELLED.
Every saga payload defined once in shared; producers and consumers use it; tests check the contract.
Exactly one payment success/failure notification per order, naming it (and the reason).
Saga logic unit-tested without Kafka or a database; each test seen failing once.
An order placed in the UI shows CONFIRMED on the Orders page within 10 s.
Changed services rebuilt and healthy; G3/G4 closed; architecture event table and READMEs updated.
